race.title: Podkovan Zero To Hero Handicap Chase
race.verdict: CHOSEN HERO , like many before her, was much improved for the switch to James Owen when a comfortable hurdles scorer at Lingfield recently and is taken to follow up reverted to fences off a still handy-looking mark. Walk The Plank has been in excellent nick since the cheekpieces went on and rates the main danger, although course specialist Cloudy Wednesday and C&D scorer Helios Allen can also play a prominent role. CHOSEN HERO (IRE) WALK THE PLANK (IRE) CLOUDY WEDNESDAY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Helios Allen (5/2), Chosen Hero (10/3), Cloudy Wednesday (11/2), Kaproyale (6/1), Kally Des Bruyeres (10/1), Walk The Plank (12/1), Forcetoreckonwith (12/1), Universal Secret (16/1), Slievehill (20/1), McGrath From Clune (20/1)
